pearls.purpose: Admin-only configuration pearl for the TeleScreen sidecar. It stores sidecar config and secrets inside the grain, claims HTTP-out to the sidecar host through Sandstorm Grapple, and pushes signed config updates. It is not a screening app and offers no consumer-facing capability.

requests.name: telescreen-sidecar-http-out
requests.purpose: HTTP-out capability for https://telescreen.sidecar.host so the configurator can read status and push sidecar configuration.

adminOnly.name: Configure TeleScreen sidecar
adminOnly.purpose: Edit sidecar settings, secrets, platform toggles, crawl settings, and push signed configuration to the sidecar.

blockchains.purpose: Release attestation only. The Configurator does not perform on-chain actions at runtime.

httpOut.purpose: Read status from and push configuration to the TeleScreen sidecar.

capnp.name: grain.UiView
capnp.purpose: Standard Sandstorm grain interface for opening the configurator UI. No matchRequests or consumer-facing offers are advertised.

http.name: GET /, GET /status, POST /api/push
http.purpose: Configurator UI and signed sidecar configuration push endpoints inside the grain WebSession.
